    Minimal representation-infinite algebras are connected #

    If e is a central idempotent of B and both B / Be and B / B(1-e) are representation-finite, so is B: an indecomposable module is killed by e or by 1 - e (isRepresentationFinite_of_centralIdempotent). Hence a minimal representation-infinite algebra has no central idempotent other than 0 and 1 (IsMinimalRepInfinite.central_idempotent).
